entries.title: OpenAI launches a limited preview of GPT-5.6 for a 'small group of trusted partners'
entries.summary: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 comes in three variants, including its most powerful and its most affordable models yet.
entries.excerpt: OpenAI has startedpreviewing its GPT‑5.6 series, which will be available in three versions, to a limited number of trusted partners. The company says the variant Sol is its strongest model yet, while Terra is for everyday use and has a similar performance to GPT‑5.5 despite being twice as cheap. Luna, the last variant, is the company's lowest cost model. OpenAI plans to give them a broad release sometime in the coming weeks.
